name: io.github.lucyfox199818-collab/ccxt-mcp
title: Codex CCXT MCP
description: Dry-run-first CCXT MCP with market, account, derivatives, and guarded trading tools.

environmentVariables.name: BINANCE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Binance API key for private account data and explicitly enabled trading.

environmentVariables.name: CCXT_SANDBOX
environmentVariables.description: Use the exchange sandbox when supported.

environmentVariables.name: CCXT_ENABLE_TRADING
environmentVariables.description: Explicit live-trading permission gate. Keep false for read-only and dry-run use.

environmentVariables.name: CCXT_DRY_RUN
environmentVariables.description: Return simulated results for mutating tools instead of sending exchange actions.
